messages:
Omar: Big life news! Got engaged last night 🎉💍 and today marks my 6-year anniversary at Redwood. Totally crying and celebrating at the same time. Would you all humbly accept a tiny office potluck next Wednesday 5pm?
Jen: OMG OMAR!!! congrats x a million :tada::sparkling_heart: This calls for cake and confetti. 5pm wed works for me.
Kai: Congrats!! :raised_hands: I can bring something savory. Also, any dress code for the party? Asking for a friend.
Priya: Love this! Congrats Omar. Ill bring a salad and a playlist. Also can we do a tiny card for the anniversary/engagement?
Marco: :party_popper: Huge congrats dude. Ill handle drinks. Vote: cake vs empanadas vs sushi?
Omar: Heh pick whatever you want. Im just happy to eat and cry happy tears. Cake is my vibe but sushi sounds fancy.
Kai: :cake:
Jen: :taco: (empanadas bc celebrations)
Priya: :fish_cake: sushi (but Ill eat cake too)
party-bot: Reminder created: "Omar double celebration" at 2934633600 (Wed 17:00) — react to RSVP by EOD Monday.
Omar: Thanks friends. Will bring a few candid-ish engagement pics and some embarrassing prom-era photos for shame. No gifts please, just vibes. :heart:
